sources.content: The brontavo-agent image runs the Brontavo backup agent, which copies database dumps to object storage on a schedule. It is built on alpine:3.20 and runs as a non-root user named brontavo with user ID 10500. The agent exposes a status API on port 8085. Mount the directory to back up read-only at /data, and mount a writable volume at /var/cache/brontavo for staging files before upload. The entrypoint is /usr/bin/brontavo-agent with the default command run.

Set BRONTAVO_SCHEDULE to a cron expression to choose when backups run; it defaults to 0 2 * * *, which is 02:00 every day. BRONTAVO_RETENTION_DAYS sets how long old backups are kept and defaults to 30. BRONTAVO_BUCKET names the target bucket and has no default, so the container exits at startup if it is unset. BRONTAVO_COMPRESSION accepts zstd or gzip and defaults to zstd. The health check queries /status/health every 30 seconds and allows two failures before marking the container unhealthy.
